headline: Dimensional Prison
title: Dimensional Prison Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Dimensional Prison. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card. What does it do? When your opponent's monster declares an attack, banish that attacking monster. How do you use it? Set it and wait for an attack. Banishing is stronger than destroying, because a banished monster cannot be revived from the Graveyard. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
